name: S&P 500 Sector Daily Performance Heatmap
description: Daily simple return heatmap across all 11 GICS sector ETFs (XLK, XLF, XLE, XLV, XLI, XLY, XLP, XLB, XLRE, XLC, XLU). Heatmap shows daily returns with diverging Red→White→Green color scale clamped at ±2%. Summary table shows Avg Daily Return, Std Dev, Best Day, and Worst Day per sector.
source:
# S&P 500 Sector Daily Performance Heatmap
# Tracks daily simple returns across all 11 GICS sector ETFs
# Heatmap: date × sector, diverging Red→White→Green, clamped ±2%
# Table: Avg Return, Std Dev, Best Day, Worst Day per sector

# --- Data ---
src = study_assets()

# --- Daily Simple Returns ---
daily_ret = (src.c - (src.c >> 1)) / (src.c >> 1)

# --- Heatmap: Daily Returns by Sector × Date ---
# cs_heatmap in values mode: one row per asset, x-axis = time
# Color: Red (negative) → White (zero) → Green (positive), clamped ±2%
cs_heatmap(
    mode=HeatmapMode.values,
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    title="Which Sectors Are Moving — and How Much?",
    category="Sector Performance",
    color_stops=ColorStopSchema(stops=[
        ColorStop(value=0.0, color=Color.Red),
        ColorStop(value=0.5, color=Color.White),
        ColorStop(value=1.0, color=Color.Green)
    ]),
    color_axis_min=-0.02,
    color_axis_max=0.02,
    show_data_labels=False,
    max_assets=11,
    value_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    order=1
)(daily_ret)

# --- Summary Table: Per-Sector Return Statistics ---
# Avg daily return, std dev, best day, worst day
# Rolling aggregates over the full window (rolling form preserves per-asset series)
# FIX: expanding agg(src, Type, cross_sectional=False) collapses multi-asset to single series
avg_ret = agg(daily_ret, 10, AggregationType.Mean)
std_ret = agg(daily_ret, 10, AggregationType.Std)
best_day = agg(daily_ret, 10, AggregationType.Max)
worst_day = agg(daily_ret, 10, AggregationType.Min)

cs_summary_table(
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    title="Sector Return Statistics — Sorted by Avg Daily Return",
    category="Sector Performance",
    order=0,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title="Sector Return Statistics",
        include_timestamp=False,
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Avg Daily Return", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Std Dev", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Best Day", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Worst Day", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    filters=AssetFilterSchema(filters=[
        AssetFilter(column=0, count=11, rank=AssetFilterRank.Top)
    ])
)(avg_ret, std_ret, best_day, worst_day)
